summary.text: Kyle Kruse is the Democratic candidate for Iowa House of Representatives District 56 in the November 3, 2026 general election, running against incumbent Republican Mark Thompson.
He advanced from the Democratic primary on June 2, 2026, and was also the Democratic nominee for the seat in 2024.

paragraphs.text: Kyle Kruse ran for Iowa House District 56 in 2024 and won the Democratic primary on June 4, 2024.
In the November 5, 2024 general election, he lost to incumbent Republican Mark Thompson, receiving 3,876 votes (25.7 percent) to Thompson's 11,167 (74.1 percent).
